baseline_prompt: You are a customer messaging specialist for small businesses. Write a set of customer messages for the journey and channels below. First give a message map as a table: message name, trigger, who gets it, when it sends, channel, the link or screen it opens, and when it stops. Then write every message in my voice, within the channel's length limits (show the character count for texts and push notifications), with fill-in fields in square brackets for anything I have not given. Give two versions of the most important messages so I can test them. Add opt-out wording to marketing messages. Use only the facts, prices and policies I give; do not invent dates, fees, names or reviews. Review requests must go to every customer and must not offer rewards.

Messages to people who did not agree to hear from you
Review gating, paying for reviews or fake reviews
Medical, legal or financial advice inside the messages
Legal notices such as eviction, debt or formal rent demands
Setting up or sending the messages in your tools
Passwords, card numbers or patient records in the brief

sample_briefs.text: Bloom & Blade, a two-chair hair salon in Bristol. We want texts for bookings: a confirmation, a reminder 48 hours before, one 2 hours before, a reschedule note and a thank-you. Cancellations need 24 hours' notice or we keep the £15 deposit. Book online at bloomandblade.co.uk/book. Friendly, short, no emojis.

Harbor Paws, a vet clinic in Portland, Maine. We need email and text reminders for vaccines: due in 30 days, due this week, two weeks overdue, and the annual check-up. Phone (207) 555-0148, book at harborpaws.vet/book. No medical advice in the messages, just that it is time and how to book.

Crumb Theory bakery ships cakes across the UK. Write order emails: confirmation, dispatched, delayed (weather or courier), and arrived with storage tips. Our cakes keep 3 days in an airtight tin and 2 months frozen. Orders before 2pm ship the same day, Monday to Thursday. 6 messages in total.

Stridely is a running app. We need 20 push notifications: 8 for onboarding in week one, 6 to bring back users who have not logged a run in 10 days, and 6 for streaks. Push titles max 40 characters, body max 110. Each should say which screen it opens: Home, Log Run, Plans or Streaks. Two versions of the first three.

Northfield Insurance Agency, 4 agents in Ohio. A renewal reminder series for home and auto policies: email at 60 days, email and text at 30 days, text at 7 days. Tell clients what to check (address, drivers, mileage) and to call (614) 555-0123. Do not mention rates or give coverage advice. Sign off as 'The Northfield team'.

demand_sources.note: YunoJuno's freelancer rate guide lists copywriters at an average of $67 an hour, about £408 a day.
University of Kentucky pilot: of 577 patients sent a text reminder 24 hours ahead, 39% confirmed and 82% of those came; the author estimated a 1:6 return.

rubric.text: Plain words, with each term explained.

baseline_prompt: You are an email deliverability specialist. Using the DNS records, platform, volumes and sending results I paste below, check my setup and write a fix plan. Check each SPF, DKIM, DMARC and return-path record against what my platform needs and show the full corrected record. Give a DMARC rollout plan from p=none to quarantine and reject, with timing. If I need it, give a day-by-day warm-up schedule starting with my most engaged contacts, a read of my last 60 days of results with a pause-and-restart plan, list cleaning rules and a sunset flow, and a consent checklist. Give numbered steps and a way to check each fix worked. Use only what I paste; do not suggest buying lists or tricks to get past spam filters.
not_for: Changing your DNS or email settings for you
Sending to bought, rented or scraped lists
Tricks to get past spam filters, such as hidden text or rotating domains
Legal advice on email consent laws such as CAN-SPAM or GDPR
Logins to your DNS host or email platform
Writing the emails themselves (see the email sequence jobs)

sample_briefs.text: Our Klaviyo emails for Saltwater Candle Co. started going to spam in Gmail 3 weeks ago. Domain saltwatercandle.com, DNS at Cloudflare. SPF, DKIM and DMARC records pasted. We send 3 campaigns a week to 18,000 contacts. Last 60 days of results pasted: opens fell from 38% to 19%, and the complaint rate hit 0.4% on two sends. Full check please.

New sending domain mail.ridgelineroofing.com for Mailchimp. We plan to email 6,500 past customers starting next month. DNS at GoDaddy. The records we added are pasted. Check them and give me a warm-up plan.

We use Google Workspace and HubSpot at Larkspur Recruiting. Our SPF record (pasted) has includes for Google, HubSpot, Zendesk, Mailgun and an old Constant Contact one. No DMARC yet. 2 domains: larkspurrecruit.com and larkspur.co.uk. Fix the records and give a DMARC rollout plan.

List cleaning rules and a sunset flow for Bramble Books, 14,000 subscribers on Mailchimp. About 5,200 have not opened in 12 months. Some contacts came from a 2019 trade show list. Our sign-up form text is pasted.

demand_sources.note: Google's email sender guidelines require anyone sending over 5,000 messages a day to Gmail to set up SPF, DKIM and DMARC, offer one-click unsubscribe and keep spam rates below 0.30%.
Yahoo's sender requirements ask bulk senders for SPF and DKIM, a DMARC policy of at least p=none, one-click unsubscribe honoured within 2 days and a spam rate below 0.3%.

gates: Facts trace to a source: every fact, price, quote and claim comes from the brief, the captured context or a cited source.
No invented numbers: every figure is supplied, captured, or calculated with the working shown.
Access respected: the agent acted only at the access level the client granted for each tool.
No fillable placeholders: nothing is left blank or bracketed that the brief or the captured context could have filled.
The diagnosis is made from the client's real data or pages, pulled at level 1 (read), with the period stated.

craft_rubric.criterion: Diagnosis specific to this account or data
craft_rubric.test: It explains why this client's numbers or pages look the way they do, not a generic checklist score. Each finding cites the data, page or screenshot it came from, with dates and the period checked.

Fixes are ranked by expected impact and effort, each specific enough to act on today.
